name: Ranger: choosing a specialization, then buying ranks from the Book of Ascension keeps Skullpiercer rank 1 client-known (#5988)
contract: #5988 The Ascension client (patch-B ClassResources.lua) draws the Ranger Advantage bar for every specialization only while IsSpellIDKnown(802036), Skullpiercer rank 1. The report: a level 10 Ranger chooses a specialization, and the first spell rank then learned from the Book of Ascension makes the bar disappear, on all three specializations. Two server packets could make the client forget 802036: SMSG_SUPERCEDED_SPELL when Skullpiercer rank 2 (501715) replaces it, and SMSG_SEND_UNLEARN_SPELLS, which every learned rank of a ranked Focus spell without a superseding SkillLineAbility row (here Wild Strike rank 2, 501724) sends with each inactive lower rank whose next rank is known. Expected: for Archery (28), Survival (29) and Dueling (30), after choosing the specialization at level 10, buying 501715 and then 501724 from the book, and a relog, the client still knows 802036.
